# Computing Variables

This R file takes in the anonymized data and calculates a whole bunch of variables (e.g., number of resources used, matching the resources across the different time points, etc).


```{r preamble, echo=FALSE, eval=TRUE}
library(ggplot2)
library('scales')
library(Hmisc)
library(corrplot)
library(psych)
library(psy)
library(reshape2)
library(reshape)
library(lme4)
library(nlme)
library(lmerTest)

#source("Graphs/summarySE.R")
#source('bm.mediation.r')

study1 = read.csv("study1_anonymized_release.csv", header=TRUE)
study2 = read.csv("study2_anonymized_release.csv", header=TRUE)
```



```{r preparing-student-background-variables, echo=FALSE, eval=TRUE}
#pre_intervention_GPA
study1$pre_intervention_GPA = as.numeric(as.character(study1$pre_intervention_GPA))
study1$highschoolGPA = as.numeric(as.character(study1$highschoolGPA))

#race
study1$race_dummy = factor(study1$race, levels=c("White/Caucasian", "Black", "Asian", 
                                                 "Hispanic/ Latino/ Chicano/ Puerto Rican"),
                           labels=c("White/Caucasian", "Black", "Asian", "Hispanic"))

study1$classstanding = as.factor(study1$classstanding)

study2$pre_intervention_GPA = as.numeric(as.character(study2$pre_intervention_GPA))
study2$highschoolGPA_num = as.numeric(as.character(study2$highschoolGPA))
study2$highschoolGPA[study2$highschoolGPA_num == 1]  = 2.0  # Note this is actually "2.0 or lower"
study2$highschoolGPA[study2$highschoolGPA_num == 2]  = 2.1
study2$highschoolGPA[study2$highschoolGPA_num == 3]  = 2.2
study2$highschoolGPA[study2$highschoolGPA_num == 4]  = 2.3
study2$highschoolGPA[study2$highschoolGPA_num == 5]  = 2.4
study2$highschoolGPA[study2$highschoolGPA_num == 6]  = 2.5  
study2$highschoolGPA[study2$highschoolGPA_num == 7]  = 2.6
study2$highschoolGPA[study2$highschoolGPA_num == 8]  = 2.7 
study2$highschoolGPA[study2$highschoolGPA_num == 9]  = 2.8
study2$highschoolGPA[study2$highschoolGPA_num == 10] = 2.9
study2$highschoolGPA[study2$highschoolGPA_num == 11] = 3.0
study2$highschoolGPA[study2$highschoolGPA_num == 12] = 3.1
study2$highschoolGPA[study2$highschoolGPA_num == 13] = 3.2
study2$highschoolGPA[study2$highschoolGPA_num == 14] = 3.3
study2$highschoolGPA[study2$highschoolGPA_num == 15] = 3.4
study2$highschoolGPA[study2$highschoolGPA_num == 16] = 3.5
study2$highschoolGPA[study2$highschoolGPA_num == 17] = 3.6
study2$highschoolGPA[study2$highschoolGPA_num == 18] = 3.7
study2$highschoolGPA[study2$highschoolGPA_num == 19] = 3.8
study2$highschoolGPA[study2$highschoolGPA_num == 20] = 3.9
study2$highschoolGPA[study2$highschoolGPA_num == 21] = 4.0
study2$highschoolGPA[study2$highschoolGPA_num == 22] = NA

# race
study2$race_dummy = factor(study2$race, levels=c("White/Caucasian", "Black", "Asian", 
                                                 "Hispanic/ Latino/ Chicano/ Puerto Rican"),
                           labels=c("White/Caucasian", "Black", "Asian", "Hispanic"))


### --- Calculating number of surveys completed --- ###
study1$number_pre_complete = rowSums(study1[, c("didSurveyPreE1", "didSurveyPreE2")], na.rm=T)
study1$number_post_complete = rowSums(study1[, c("didSurveyPostE1", "didSurveyPostE2")], na.rm=T)
study1$total_surveys_complete = rowSums(study1[, c("didSurveyPreE1", "didSurveyPreE2", "didSurveyPostE1", "didSurveyPostE2")], na.rm=T)

study2$number_pre_complete = rowSums(study2[, c("didSurveyPreE1", "didSurveyPreE2")], na.rm=T)
study2$number_post_complete = rowSums(study2[, c("didSurveyPostE1", "didSurveyPostE2")], na.rm=T)
study2$total_surveys_complete = rowSums(study2[, c("didSurveyPreE1", "didSurveyPreE2", "didSurveyPostE1", "didSurveyPostE2")], na.rm=T)


## Exam and Final Course Performance EXCLUDING Bonus Points/ Extra Credit
  # study1
study1$grade_nobonus = study1$grade - (study1$total_surveys_complete*0.67)
study1$exam_1_nobonus = study1$exam_1 - (study1$didSurveyPreE1*0.67)
study1$exam_2_nobonus = study1$exam_2 - (study1$didSurveyPreE2*0.67)

  #study2
study2$grade_nobonus = study2$grade - (study2$total_surveys_complete*0.80)
study2$exam_1_nobonus = study2$exam_1 - (study2$didSurveyPreE1*0.80)
study2$exam_2_nobonus = study2$exam_2 - (study2$didSurveyPreE2*0.80)
```

## Open-ended responses
```{r open-ended responses, echo=FALSE, eval=TRUE, results='hide'}

# For paper: five main strategies that they mentioned which were consistent with self-regulation theory: (1) explicit consideration of the exam format, (2) leveraging multiple resources synergistically, (3) a focus on promoting learning or understanding of the class material, (4) illustrating an understanding of personal strengths and weaknesses, and (5) recognizing that learning is a social process. 

### Creating the engagement degree variables ###

# Study 1
study1$why1_examformat <- rowSums(study1[,c("E1_why1_relate.to.exam.format","E2_why1_relate.to.exam.format")], na.rm=TRUE)
study1$why2_otherres <- rowSums(study1[,c("E1_why2_relate.to.other.resources","E2_why2_relate.to.other.resources")], na.rm=TRUE)
study1$why3_learnundst <- rowSums(study1[,c("E1_why3_promote.learning.or.understanding","E2_why3_promote.learning.or.understanding")], na.rm=TRUE)
study1$why4_selfknow <- rowSums(study1[,c("E1_why4_understanding.of.self","E2_why4_understanding.of.self")], na.rm=TRUE)
study1$why5_sociallearn <- rowSums(study1[,c("E1_why5_recognize.social.learning.process","E1_why5_recognize.social.learning.process")], na.rm=TRUE)

study1$plan1_when <- rowSums(study1[,c("E1_plan1_when","E2_plan1_when")], na.rm=TRUE)
study1$plan2_where <- rowSums(study1[,c("E1_plan2_where","E2_plan2_where")], na.rm=TRUE)
study1$plan3_how <- rowSums(study1[,c("E1_plan3_how","E2_plan3_how")], na.rm=TRUE)


# Study 2
study2$why1_examformat <- rowSums(study2[,c("E1_why1_relate.to.exam.format","E2_why1_relate.to.exam.format")], na.rm=TRUE)
study2$why2_otherres <- rowSums(study2[,c("E1_why2_relate.to.other.resources","E2_why2_relate.to.other.resources")], na.rm=TRUE)
study2$why3_learnundst <- rowSums(study2[,c("E1_why3_promote.learning.or.understanding","E2_why3_promote.learning.or.understanding")], na.rm=TRUE)
study2$why4_selfknow <- rowSums(study2[,c("E1_why4_understanding.of.self","E2_why4_understanding.of.self")], na.rm=TRUE)
study2$why5_sociallearn <- rowSums(study2[,c("E1_why5_recognize.social.learning.process","E1_why5_recognize.social.learning.process")], na.rm=TRUE)

study2$plan1_when <- rowSums(study2[,c("E1_plan1_when","E2_plan1_when")], na.rm=TRUE)
study2$plan2_where <- rowSums(study2[,c("E1_plan2_where","E2_plan2_where")], na.rm=TRUE)
study2$plan3_how <- rowSums(study2[,c("E1_plan3_how","E2_plan3_how")], na.rm=TRUE)
```


## Emotion and Motivation variables
```{r aggregating-emotions-across-exams-and-cohorts, echo=FALSE, results='hide', eval=TRUE}

### Calculating variables ###
## study1 ##
  # anxious, frustrated, insecure
cronbach(study1[,c("Anxious","Frustrated","Insecure")])
cronbach(study1[,c("Anxious_E2","Frustrated_E2","Insecure_E2")])

study1$E1_negemotions = rowMeans(study1[,c("Anxious","Frustrated","Insecure")], na.rm=TRUE)
study1$E2_negemotions = rowMeans(study1[,c("Anxious_E2","Frustrated_E2","Insecure_E2")], na.rm=TRUE)



### Rescaling variables so that study1 and study2 DVs match on scale ###

   # rescaling variables to match study2 dataset #
   # Study 1 was measured on a 1-9 Likert scale; while Study 2 was measured on a 1-7 Likert scale
   # To do this, if a response was "X" on Study 1, it'll become:
   #     (X - 1) * 6/8 + 1
   #  on Study 2, because:
   #      1) have to shift 1-9 to 0-8, so we subtract 1
   #      2) then rescale to become 0-6, so we multiply by 6/8
   #      3) then we need to change 0-6 to 1-7, so we add 1

  study1$E1_negemotions_orig = study1$E1_negemotions
  study1$E1_negemotions = (study1$E1_negemotions_orig-1)/8*6 + 1
  study1$control.over.grade_orig = study1$control.over.grade
  study1$control.over.grade = (study1$control.over.grade_orig-1)/8*5 + 1              # 6-point scale in study2
  study1$extent.of.planning_poE1_orig = study1$extent.of.planning_poE1
  study1$extent.of.planning_poE1 = (study1$extent.of.planning_poE1_orig-1)/8*6 + 1    # 7-point scale in study2
  
  study1$kept.to.plans_poE1[study1$kept.to.plans_poE1==1] = NA
  study1$kept.to.plans_poE1[study1$kept.to.plans_poE1==2] = 1
  study1$kept.to.plans_poE1[study1$kept.to.plans_poE1==3] = 2
  study1$kept.to.plans_poE1[study1$kept.to.plans_poE1==4] = 3
  study1$kept.to.plans_poE1[study1$kept.to.plans_poE1==5] = 4
  study1$kept.to.plans_poE1[study1$kept.to.plans_poE1==6] = 5
  study1$kept.to.plans_poE1[study1$kept.to.plans_poE1==7] = 6
  study1$kept.to.plans_poE1[study1$kept.to.plans_poE1==8] = 7
  study1$kept.to.plans_poE1[study1$kept.to.plans_poE1==9] = 8
  study1$kept.to.plans_poE1[study1$kept.to.plans_poE1==10] = 9
  
  study1$kept.to.plans_poE1 = (study1$kept.to.plans_poE1-1)/8*6 + 1
  
  # from 9 point to 7 point
  study1$motivation_orig = study1$motivation
  study1$motivation = (study1$motivation_orig-1)/8*6 + 1
  study1$importance_orig = study1$importance
  study1$importance = (study1$importance_orig-1)/8*6 + 1
  study1$confidence_orig = study1$confidence
  study1$confidence = (study1$confidence_orig-1)/8*6 + 1
  
  study1$motivation_E2_orig = study1$motivation_E2
  study1$motivation_E2 = (study1$motivation_E2_orig-1)/8*6 + 1
  study1$importance_E2_orig = study1$importance_E2
  study1$importance_E2 = (study1$importance_E2_orig-1)/8*6 + 1
  study1$confidence_E2_orig = study1$confidence_E2
  study1$confidence_E2 = (study1$confidence_E2_orig-1)/8*6 + 1

  study1$E2_negemotions_orig = study1$E2_negemotions
  study1$E2_negemotions = (study1$E2_negemotions_orig-1)/8*6 + 1
  study1$control.over.grade_E2_orig = study1$control.over.grade_E2
  study1$control.over.grade_E2 = (study1$control.over.grade_E2_orig-1)/8*5 + 1
  study1$extent.of.planning_poE2_orig = study1$extent.of.planning_poE2
  study1$extent.of.planning_poE2 = (study1$extent.of.planning_poE2_orig-1)/8*6 + 1

  study1$kept.to.plans_poE2[study1$kept.to.plans_poE2==1] = NA
  study1$kept.to.plans_poE2[study1$kept.to.plans_poE2==2] = 1
  study1$kept.to.plans_poE2[study1$kept.to.plans_poE2==3] = 2
  study1$kept.to.plans_poE2[study1$kept.to.plans_poE2==4] = 3
  study1$kept.to.plans_poE2[study1$kept.to.plans_poE2==5] = 4
  study1$kept.to.plans_poE2[study1$kept.to.plans_poE2==6] = 5
  study1$kept.to.plans_poE2[study1$kept.to.plans_poE2==7] = 6
  study1$kept.to.plans_poE2[study1$kept.to.plans_poE2==8] = 7
  study1$kept.to.plans_poE2[study1$kept.to.plans_poE2==9] = 8
  study1$kept.to.plans_poE2[study1$kept.to.plans_poE2==10] = 9
  
  study1$kept.to.plans_poE2 = (study1$kept.to.plans_poE2-1)/8*6 + 1  
  


## study2 ##
# anxious, nervous, afraid, stressed were measured as the negative emotions, which students felt about their exams.
cronbach(study2[,c("anxious", "nervous", "afraid", "stressed")])
cronbach(study2[,c("anxious_E2", "nervous_E2", "afraid_E2", "stressed_E2")])

study2$E1_negemotions = rowMeans(study2[,c("anxious", "nervous", "afraid", "stressed")], na.rm=TRUE) 
study2$E2_negemotions = rowMeans(study2[,c("anxious_E2", "nervous_E2", "afraid_E2", "stressed_E2")], na.rm=TRUE)

# control over grade variables
study2$control.over.grade = rowMeans(study2[,c("control.over.grade.q1", "control.over.grade.q2")], na.rm=TRUE)
study2$control.over.grade_E2 = rowMeans(study2[,c("control.over.grade_E2.q1", "control.over.grade_E2.q2")], na.rm=TRUE)

```



# Resources


## Matching Resources Planned and Resources Used
```{r calculating-resource-match-plan-and-did, echo=FALSE, eval=TRUE, warning='false'}

  # calculating variables to match pre and post EXAM 1 #

# We have 5 important variables:
# group = 1 if they were in the treatment planning group
# didPre = 1 if they did the pre exam survey
# didPost = 1 if they did the post exam survey
# plannedPre = 1 if that particular resource was planned during the pre exam survey
# usedPost = 1 if that particular resource was used during the post exam survey
#
# We use a bitmap mapping to map these 5 variables into a number from 0-31. Not every number is possible, but
#  the possibilities are listed in the following table.
#    where "bitValue" = 2^4*group + 2^3 * didPre + 2^2 * plannedPre + 2^1 * didPost + 2^0 * usedPost
#                     = 16*group  + 8*didPre + 4*plannedPre + 2*didPost + 1*usedPost
# We grouped the variables into 7 groups:
#     Planned Did
#     Planned NotDid
#     NotPlanned Did
#     NotPlanned NotDid
#     Planless Did
#     Planless NotDid
#     NA
#
#  and we used the following table to group the bitValues to these codes:
# 
# group didPre plannedPre   didPost  usedPost    bitValue    code
#   1      1        1         1       1             31       Planned Did
#   1      1        1         1       NA            30       Planned NotDid
#   1      1        NA        1       1             27       NotPlanned Did
#   1      1        NA        1       NA            26       NotPlanned NotDid
#
#   1      1        1         NA      NA            28       NA (can't tell if they did)
#   1      1        NA        NA      NA            24       NA (can't tell if they did)
#   1      NA       NA        1        1            19       Planless Did
#   1      NA       NA        1       NA            18       Planless NotDid
#   1      NA       NA        NA      NA            16       NA (can't tell if they did)
#
#   0      1         NA       1        1            11     Planless Did
#   0      1         NA       1        NA           10     Planless NotDid
#   0      1         NA       NA       NA           8      NA (can't tell if they did)
#   0      NA        NA       1        1            3      Planless Did
#   0      NA        NA       1        NA           2      Planless NotDid
#   0      NA        NA       NA       NA           0      NA (can't tell if they did)

# using the following code:
study1$exam1_matched_resource_Lecture.notes = factor( (16*(study1[,"group"]==1)) +
                                                      (8*!is.na(study1[,"didSurveyPreE1"])) +
                                                      (4*!is.na(study1[,"Lecture.notes"])) +
                                                      (2*!is.na(study1[,"didSurveyPostE1"])) +
                                                      (1*!is.na(study1[,"used_Lecture.notes_poE1"])),
                                                      levels=c(31,30,27,26,  19,11,3,  18,10,2),
                                                      labels=c("Planned Did", "Planned NotDid", 
                                                               "NotPlanned Did", "NotPlanned NotDid",
                                                               "Planless Did", "Planless Did", "Planless Did",
                                                               "Planless NotDid", "Planless NotDid", "Planless NotDid"))
study1$exam1_matched_resource_Lecture.notes = factor(study1$exam1_matched_resource_Lecture.notes) # need this line to drop repeated levels

study1$exam1_matched_resource_Blue.Review = factor( (16*(study1[,"group"]==1)) +
                                                    (8*!is.na(study1[,"didSurveyPreE1"])) +
                                                    (4*!is.na(study1[,"Blue.Review"])) +
                                                    (2*!is.na(study1[,"didSurveyPostE1"])) +
                                                    (1*!is.na(study1[,"used_Blue.Review_poE1"])),
                                                    levels=c(31,30,27,26,  19,11,3,  18,10,2),
                                                    labels=c("Planned Did", "Planned NotDid", 
                                                             "NotPlanned Did", "NotPlanned NotDid",
                                                             "Planless Did", "Planless Did", "Planless Did",
                                                             "Planless NotDid", "Planless NotDid", "Planless NotDid"))
study1$exam1_matched_resource_Blue.Review = factor(study1$exam1_matched_resource_Blue.Review) # need this line to drop repeated levels

study1$exam1_matched_resource_Past.req.HW = factor( (16*(study1[,"group"]==1)) +
                                                    (8*!is.na(study1[,"didSurveyPreE1"])) +
                                                    (4*!is.na(study1[,"Past.required.HW.problems"])) +
                                                    (2*!is.na(study1[,"didSurveyPostE1"])) +
                                                    (1*!is.na(study1[,"used_Past.required.HW.problems_poE1"])),
                                                    levels=c(31,30,27,26,  19,11,3,  18,10,2),
                                                    labels=c("Planned Did", "Planned NotDid", 
                                                             "NotPlanned Did", "NotPlanned NotDid",
                                                             "Planless Did", "Planless Did", "Planless Did",
                                                             "Planless NotDid", "Planless NotDid", "Planless NotDid"))
study1$exam1_matched_resource_Past.req.HW = factor(study1$exam1_matched_resource_Past.req.HW) # need this line to drop repeated levels

study1$exam1_matched_resource_Past.rec.HW = factor( (16*(study1[,"group"]==1)) +
                                                    (8*!is.na(study1[,"didSurveyPreE1"])) +
                                                    (4*!is.na(study1[,"Past.recommended.HW.problems"])) +
                                                    (2*!is.na(study1[,"didSurveyPostE1"])) +
                                                    (1*!is.na(study1[,"used_Past.recommended.HW.problems_poE1"])),
                                                    levels=c(31,30,27,26,  19,11,3,  18,10,2),
                                                    labels=c("Planned Did", "Planned NotDid", 
                                                             "NotPlanned Did", "NotPlanned NotDid",
                                                             "Planless Did", "Planless Did", "Planless Did",
                                                             "Planless NotDid", "Planless NotDid", "Planless NotDid"))
study1$exam1_matched_resource_Past.rec.HW = factor(study1$exam1_matched_resource_Past.rec.HW) # need this line to drop repeated levels

study1$exam1_matched_resource_Prac.exam.qn = factor( (16*(study1[,"group"]==1)) +
                                                     (8*!is.na(study1[,"didSurveyPreE1"])) +
                                                     (4*!is.na(
                                                    study1[,"Practice.exam.questions..from.the.lab.workbook."])) +
                                                     (2*!is.na(study1[,"didSurveyPostE1"])) +
                                                     (1*!is.na(
                                                study1[,"used_Practice.exam.questions..from.the.lab.workbook._poE1"])),
                                                     levels=c(31,30,27,26,  19,11,3,  18,10,2),
                                                     labels=c("Planned Did", "Planned NotDid", 
                                                              "NotPlanned Did", "NotPlanned NotDid",
                                                              "Planless Did", "Planless Did", "Planless Did",
                                                              "Planless NotDid", "Planless NotDid", "Planless NotDid"))
study1$exam1_matched_resource_Prac.exam.qn = factor(study1$exam1_matched_resource_Prac.exam.qn) # need this line to drop repeated levels

study1$exam1_matched_resource_PR = factor( (16*(study1[,"group"]==1)) +
                                           (8*!is.na(study1[,"didSurveyPreE1"])) +
                                           (4*!is.na(study1[,"Problem.Roulette"])) +
                                           (2*!is.na(study1[,"didSurveyPostE1"])) +
                                           (1*!is.na(study1[,"used_Problem.Roulette_poE1"])),
                                           levels=c(31,30,27,26,  19,11,3,  18,10,2),
                                           labels=c("Planned Did", "Planned NotDid", 
                                                    "NotPlanned Did", "NotPlanned NotDid",
                                                    "Planless Did", "Planless Did", "Planless Did",
                                                    "Planless NotDid", "Planless NotDid", "Planless NotDid"))
study1$exam1_matched_resource_PR = factor(study1$exam1_matched_resource_PR) # need this line to drop repeated levels

study1$exam1_matched_resource_NTS = factor( (16*(study1[,"group"]==1)) +
                                            (8*!is.na(study1[,"didSurveyPreE1"])) +
                                            (4*!is.na(study1[,"Name.That.Scenario"])) +
                                            (2*!is.na(study1[,"didSurveyPostE1"])) +
                                            (1*!is.na(study1[,"used_Name.That.Scenario_poE1"])),
                                            levels=c(31,30,27,26,  19,11,3,  18,10,2),
                                            labels=c("Planned Did", "Planned NotDid", 
                                                     "NotPlanned Did", "NotPlanned NotDid",
```

## Calculating Total Resources Planned vs. Used by Each Individual
```{r planned-vs-used, echo=FALSE, eval=TRUE}

  ### study1 ###

study1$TOTPlannedDid_E1 = rowSums(study1[,c("exam1_matched_resource_Lecture.notes", 
                                            "exam1_matched_resource_Blue.Review",                             
                                            "exam1_matched_resource_Past.req.HW",                             
                                            "exam1_matched_resource_Past.rec.HW",                             
                                            "exam1_matched_resource_Prac.exam.qn",                            
                                            "exam1_matched_resource_PR",                                      
                                            "exam1_matched_resource_NTS",                                     
                                            "exam1_matched_resource_ILP",                                     
                                            "exam1_matched_resource_Textbook",                                
                                            "exam1_matched_resource_Formula.Card",                            
                                            "exam1_matched_resource_Other.Students",                          
                                            "exam1_matched_resource_OH.Professor",                            
                                            "exam1_matched_resource_OH.GSI",                                  
                                            "exam1_matched_resource_Ask.Qn.Class",
```

## Creating Emotion and Motivational Variables Long Form Dataset.
```{r creating-emo-motiv-long-dataset, echo=FALSE, eval=TRUE}

temp1a=study1[c("ID", "group", "exam_1", 
                "TOTPlannedDid_E1", "TOTPlannedNotDid_E1",
                "TOTNotPlannedDid_E1", "TOTNotPlannedNotDid_E1",
                "TOTPlanlessDid_E1", "TOTPlanlessNotDid_E1",
                "E1_negemotions", "control.over.grade",
                "extent.of.planning_poE1", "kept.to.plans_poE1")]

colnames(temp1a) = c("ID", "group", "exam", 
                     "PlannedDid", "PlannedNotDid",
                     "NotPlannedDid", "NotPlannedNotDid",
                     "PlanlessDid", "PlanlessNotDid",
                     "negemotions","control.over.grade",
                     "extent.of.planning_poE", "kept.to.plans_poE")
temp1a$examNum = 1
temp1a$year = 0


temp1b=study1[c("ID", "group", "exam_2", 
                "TOTPlannedDid_E2", "TOTPlannedNotDid_E2",
                "TOTNotPlannedDid_E2", "TOTNotPlannedNotDid_E2",
                "TOTPlanlessDid_E2", "TOTPlanlessNotDid_E2",
                "E2_negemotions", "control.over.grade_E2",
                "extent.of.planning_poE2", "kept.to.plans_poE2")]

colnames(temp1b) = c("ID", "group", "exam", 
                     "PlannedDid", "PlannedNotDid",
                     "NotPlannedDid", "NotPlannedNotDid",
                     "PlanlessDid", "PlanlessNotDid",
                     "negemotions","control.over.grade",
                     "extent.of.planning_poE", "kept.to.plans_poE")

temp1b$examNum = 2
temp1b$year = 0

study1_stack = rbind(temp1a, temp1b) 

temp2a=study2[c("ID", "group", "exam_1", 
                "TOTPlannedDid_E1", "TOTPlannedNotDid_E1",
                "TOTNotPlannedDid_E1", "TOTNotPlannedNotDid_E1",
                "TOTPlanlessDid_E1", "TOTPlanlessNotDid_E1",
                "E1_negemotions", "control.over.grade",
                "extent.of.planning_poE1", "kept.to.plans_poE1")]

colnames(temp2a) = c("ID", "group", "exam", 
                     "PlannedDid", "PlannedNotDid",
                     "NotPlannedDid", "NotPlannedNotDid",
                     "PlanlessDid", "PlanlessNotDid",
                     "negemotions","control.over.grade",
                     "extent.of.planning_poE", "kept.to.plans_poE")
temp2a$examNum = 1
temp2a$year = 1


temp2b=study2[c("ID", "group", "exam_2", 
                "TOTPlannedDid_E2", "TOTPlannedNotDid_E2",
                "TOTNotPlannedDid_E2", "TOTNotPlannedNotDid_E2",
                "TOTPlanlessDid_E2", "TOTPlanlessNotDid_E2",
                "E2_negemotions", "control.over.grade_E2",
                "extent.of.planning_poE2", "kept.to.plans_poE2")]

colnames(temp2b) = c("ID", "group", "exam", 
                     "PlannedDid", "PlannedNotDid",
                     "NotPlannedDid", "NotPlannedNotDid",
                     "PlanlessDid", "PlanlessNotDid",
                     "negemotions","control.over.grade",
                     "extent.of.planning_poE", "kept.to.plans_poE")
temp2b$examNum = 2
temp2b$year = 1

study2_stack = rbind(temp2a, temp2b)

study1_2_stack = rbind(study1_stack, study2_stack)

emotion_motivation_dataset = study1_2_stack[,c("year", "ID", "group", "examNum", 
                  "exam", "PlannedDid", "NotPlannedDid", "PlannedNotDid", 
                  "NotPlannedNotDid", "PlanlessDid", "PlanlessNotDid",
```

## 2 Mechanisms (Resource Use & Metacog SR) Creating Dataset Combining Across Years, Not Exams 
```{r prepost, echo=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
study1_temp = study1[c("ID", "group", "grade", "allexams_MeanUsefulness", "allexamspost_numberOfResourcedUsed")]
study1_temp$strategic_behaviors_pw = NA
study1_temp$year = 0

study2_temp = study2[c("ID", "group", "grade", "allexams_MeanUsefulness", "allexamspost_numberOfResourcedUsed", "strategic_behaviors_pw")]
study2_temp$year = 1

study1_2_mechstack_prepost = rbind(study1_temp, study2_temp)
colnames(study1_2_mechstack_prepost) = c("ID", "group", "grade", "resourceuse", "numresourcesused", "selfreflection", "year")

write.csv(study1_2_mechstack_prepost, "study1and2_mechstack_prepost.csv", row.names=F)

```
